breaches.explanation: The output format of parse_config_h has intentionally changed: string-type #define values from pyconfig.h no longer include surrounding double-quotes. This is the intended behavior fix (gh-150208). Downstream code expecting quoted strings will observe a format change.

contract_details.probe: byte-level JSON comparison of parse_config_h output
contract_details.note: Intentional behavior change to fix double-quoting bug in sysconfigdata variables
